description: Implement regenerative recovery using triage, scaffolding, and progressive rebuild. Covers damage assessment, wound classification, emergency stabilization, scar tissue management, and resilience strengthening for systems that have sustained structural damage. Use when a system has suffered an incident needing structured recovery, when a failed transformation left the system in a damaged intermediate state, when accumulated technical debt has caused partial failure, or when a system is functional but degraded and the degradation is worsening.
